bot.description: Relaybench's hosted support agent; one agent, every tenant

people.description: end user who is a patient at Harbor Dental and a shipper with Kestrel Freight
end user, member of Nimbus Yoga

question: What is the refund policy, who handles escalations, and how does this customer want to be contacted?

tenants.name: Harbor Dental
facts: Harbor Dental refunds unused whitening kits in full within 14 days of purchase.
Harbor Dental escalations go to the front desk lead at the patient's home clinic, never to a dentist.

sam.pin: Sam Ortiz wants Harbor Dental appointment reminders by SMS only, never phone calls.

session.title: Moving a cleaning
turns: user
Hi, this is Sam Ortiz. I need to move my cleaning at the Harbor Dental Eastside clinic from Thursday to next week.
bot
Of course, Sam. I can offer Tuesday at 8:30 or Wednesday at 17:00 at Eastside.
user
Tuesday 8:30 works. And please text me the reminder - I never pick up calls from unknown numbers.
bot
Booked for Tuesday at 8:30. Reminders will come by SMS only.
user
Thanks. Also, my teeth are sensitive after whitening, so the hygienist should use the desensitizing paste.
bot
Noted: sensitive teeth after whitening, desensitizing paste at cleanings. See you Tuesday.

tenants.name: Kestrel Freight
facts: Kestrel Freight refunds a pallet booking in full when it is cancelled 60 or more days before pickup.
Kestrel Freight escalations go to the dispatch desk on duty, 24 hours a day.

sam.pin: Sam Ortiz wants Kestrel Freight shipment updates by phone call, weekdays only.

session.title: Missed pickup in Reno
turns: user
Sam Ortiz from Ortiz Supply. Kestrel missed our pickup at the Reno warehouse, dock 4, this morning.
bot
Sorry about that, Sam. I have rebooked the pallet pickup at Reno dock 4 for tomorrow at 9:00.
user
Good. For shipments, call me rather than email - but only on weekdays, our dock is closed on weekends.
bot
Understood: phone calls for shipment updates, weekdays only.
user
And we always ship 6 pallets of shelving per run, so make sure the truck has room.
bot
Noted: 6 pallets of shelving per run from Reno dock 4. The dispatch desk has the update.

tenants.name: Nimbus Yoga
facts: Nimbus Yoga never refunds cash; unused passes become class credits valid for 12 months.
Nimbus Yoga escalations go to the studio manager of the member's home studio.

priya.pin: Priya Nair wants Nimbus Yoga messages by email; her home studio is Oakland.

session.title: Knee injury and a paused pass
turns: user
Hi, Priya Nair here. I hurt my knee and can't come to class for a few weeks.
bot
Sorry to hear that, Priya. I can freeze your 20-class pass at the Oakland studio for up to 60 days.
user
Please do. When I'm back, teachers should know to skip kneeling poses for me.
bot
Your pass is frozen, and your profile now says: avoid kneeling poses because of a knee injury.
user
Great. Email me when the freeze ends - I don't use the app notifications.
bot
Will do: email only. The Oakland studio manager has been told about the injury.
